verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation feature that runs autonomously in the background. The scheduled Automated Full Export is a fixed backup feature, not general automations, so it is adjacent. The REST API and MCP are developer building blocks. The AI assistant proposes creates and updates for the user to approve rather than acting autonomously, and nothing shows AI auto-fill or tagging running unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
